An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
